packages.name: observe-core
packages.selection_reason: package files changed since observe-core/v0.1.0 and produced a release bump

changes.message:
feat(observe-core): V2 phase 1 — contracts, schema registry, backends, propagation

- EventContract registry with typed fields, metadata (description,
  sensitive, cardinality, deprecated, examples), and off/warn/strict
  validation wired into the emit path
- Schema registry: deterministic JSON Schema export and
  breaking/non-breaking change classification (spec §44)
- Canonical entity identifiers: <namespace>://<path> URIs with typed
  helpers (asset/run/table/iceberg/branch/model/source/snapshot/
  service/incident)
- V2 envelope: entities, tags, contract ref; additive and omitted when
  empty so 1.x emissions stay byte-compatible; envelope_version setting
- RuntimeBackend protocol with worker (default), sync, and capture
  transports; runtime keeps finalization and delegates transport
- Context propagation across process boundaries: base64url context
  envelope via OBSERVE_CONTEXT or --observe-context
- Policy-based dynamic sampling (ordered rules, run-level rates,
  failure/critical retention guarantees, recorded decisions) and a
  bounded tail sampler
- MetricAggregator + metric()/flush_metrics() for event-shaped metrics
- SDK health surface: backend, queue depth, counters, spool, tail,
  aggregation series
- event-envelope-v2.schema.json; contract tests validate V2 and pin V1

feat(sdk): emit canonical entities from integrations

- observe() accepts entities=/tags= kwargs, applied to the builder on
  enter and carried through decorator wrapping
- dagster: run://dagster/<run_id> + asset://<key> on materializations
  and asset checks
- wap: branch://nessie/<branch> plus table:// and snapshot:// when known
- iceberg: iceberg://<catalog>/<ns>/<table>, branch://nessie,
  snapshot://<table>/<id> on commits; branch entity on nessie create
- dlt: source://dlt/<pipeline>; dbt: run://dbt/<invocation> and
  model://dbt/<name> on run-results events; trino: service://trino
feat: V2 hardening: equivalence, stress, failure-injection, cross-replica SSE (#7)

feat(observe-core): add generic human-readable event renderer (#8)

* feat(observe-core): add generic human-readable event renderer

Canonical events have strong machine representations but poor human
scannability. PrettyRenderer renders envelopes as concise text driven
entirely by consumer-supplied presentation rules — labels, visibility
(primary/secondary/hidden with failure/warning escalation), field paths,
generic formatters, context grouping, and a structured error layout.
observe-core owns layout, status vocabulary and terminal behaviour
(TTY/NO_COLOR/CI detection, Unicode with ASCII fallback, optional
minimal colour); event semantics stay in the consuming application, so
the same renderer works for any application without modification.

Rendering is additive: canonical JSON/JSONL serialization is untouched.

* feat(observe-core): incremental rendering, event timestamps, custom drains

- PrettyRenderer.write_event() renders one event at a time while tracking
  context state across calls, so incremental consumers (drains,
  tail-followers) get the same grouping render_many gives a complete
  sequence: one header per context switch, no header per batch.
- timestamps=True prefixes each event line with the event time
  (HH:MM:SS.mmm from canonical observed_at, falling back to started_at
  then ended_at). Missing or malformed times render no column.
- Runtime.add_drain()/observe_core.add_drain() are the programmatic
  counterpart of OBSERVE_DRAINS: applications register Drain instances
  a drain name cannot express, without mutating the environment.
- configure_phlo accepts the name,name drain shorthand a filtered
  OBSERVE_DRAINS remainder produces.

changes.message:
feat(observe-core): V2 phase 1 — contracts, schema registry, backends, propagation

- EventContract registry with typed fields, metadata (description,
  sensitive, cardinality, deprecated, examples), and off/warn/strict
  validation wired into the emit path
- Schema registry: deterministic JSON Schema export and
  breaking/non-breaking change classification (spec §44)
- Canonical entity identifiers: <namespace>://<path> URIs with typed
  helpers (asset/run/table/iceberg/branch/model/source/snapshot/
  service/incident)
- V2 envelope: entities, tags, contract ref; additive and omitted when
  empty so 1.x emissions stay byte-compatible; envelope_version setting
- RuntimeBackend protocol with worker (default), sync, and capture
  transports; runtime keeps finalization and delegates transport
- Context propagation across process boundaries: base64url context
  envelope via OBSERVE_CONTEXT or --observe-context
- Policy-based dynamic sampling (ordered rules, run-level rates,
  failure/critical retention guarantees, recorded decisions) and a
  bounded tail sampler
- MetricAggregator + metric()/flush_metrics() for event-shaped metrics
- SDK health surface: backend, queue depth, counters, spool, tail,
  aggregation series
- event-envelope-v2.schema.json; contract tests validate V2 and pin V1

feat(observer): add V2 state engine — entity registry, edges, asset projections, rebuild

- observe_entities, observe_relationships, observe_assets, observe_baselines,
  observe_insights, observe_incidents, observe_schemas,
  observe_ingest_failures tables (migration 0003)
- events gain entities/tags/contract_id columns; runs gain provenance
- state_engine: pure reducers shared by incremental ingest and rebuild,
  giving equivalence between the two paths (spec 12.4)
- projections: entity registry, typed edges (executes/reads_from/
  writes_to/produces/validates/promotes/part_of/deployed_as), asset
  freshness/health state, bounded provenance (derived_from, rule,
  rule_version, derived_at)
- phlo-observer rebuild-projections [--run <id>]: full or scoped rebuild
  from canonical events

feat(observer): add V2 insight layer — baselines, deterministic rules, incident grouping

- observe_baselines: rolling median/MAD/p10-p90/mean over bounded window,
  partition-aware keys (spec 16)
- insights.py: six deterministic rules (run-failure, quality-failure,
  duration-regression 2x median, volume-spike 3x, freshness-breach,
  recurring-failure) with open/acknowledged/resolved/suppressed/expired
  lifecycle and dedupe keys (spec 15)
- incidents.py: entity/run/time-window grouping of error/critical
  insights; critical insights auto-open incidents (spec 17)
- ingest path: projections -> evaluate -> record -> group -> resolve ->
  update baselines (evaluation precedes baseline update so an observation
  never judges itself)

feat(observer): add V2 query API endpoints and investigation bundle

- GET /v2/runs/{id} (+entities), /timeline, /failures, /changes,
  /impact, /investigate (spec 20/22)
- GET /v2/assets/{id}, /health (status + freshness + open insights),
  /history, /lineage (upstream/downstream edges)
- GET /v2/insights (state/entity filters), /v2/incidents, /v2/incidents/{id}
- GET /v2/events/{id}/provenance - projections the event contributed to
- POST /v2/query/compare-runs - side-by-side diff with deltas
- investigation_bundle: failures, timeline, warnings, changes, comparable
  runs, impact, ranked candidate causes with evidence ids
- asset :path routes register after sub-resources so /health etc resolve

feat(observer): add V2 operations — search, SSE stream, alert webhooks, quarantine admin

- GET /v2/search: Postgres ILIKE over event name, error message, asset,
  table, service plus existing structured filters (spec 23)
- GET /v2/stream: SSE notification channel with bounded subscriber set;
  run.changed/insight.opened/incident.updated published from ingest (§26)
- alert_webhook_urls setting: fire-and-forget insight/incident POSTs,
  tracked task set, never blocks ingest (§34)
- observe_ingest_failures quarantine: payload-level normalization
  failures land here; GET /v2/admin/quarantine lists them and
  POST /v2/admin/quarantine/{id}/replay re-runs the adapter (§34)
- admin_tokens scope: separate admin authorization with read-token
  fallback (§19.4 keeps agent reads read-only)
- new observe-query package: ObserverClient read-only typed client +
  AGENT_TOOLS dispatch table for the spec 19.2 tool surface

feat(observer): add V2 lifecycle and registry endpoints, operator CLIs, archive/restore

- POST /v2/insights/{id}/transition + /v2/incidents/{id}/transition:
  lifecycle states open/acknowledged/resolved/suppressed/expired (15.3)
- GET /v2/entities: registry listing with kind filter
- GET/POST /v2/schemas: contract schema registry, auto-registered on
  ingest when envelopes carry contract.schema_id (8.3)
- POST/GET /v2/analyses: LLM analysis provenance with evidence IDs
  (21.4/24.2 observe_agent_analyses, migration 0004)
- phlo-observer archive/restore: JSONL export + canonical-path re-ingest;
  reprocess: windowed projection replay (24.3)
- phlo-observe CLI: doctor, schemas list/validate, events tail --follow,
  run show/compare, incident show, replay, benchmark (37)

feat(observer): add WAP branch state projection and retention for V2 tables

- branch:// entities now accumulate lifecycle attributes from WAP/Nessie
  verbs: create(open+base_branch), validate(validation+validated_at),
  promote(promoted|promotion_failed+target), reject(rejected),
  cleanup(cleaned), commit(last_commit_at+last_snapshot_id); merge is
  last-write-wins and identical on incremental and rebuild paths
- retention now expires terminal-state insights/incidents on the run
  window (open items are live signal and never deleted), plus quarantined
  IngestFailure rows and AgentAnalysis records (24.x retention)

docs: add V2 docs page and archive/restore roundtrip coverage

- docs/v2.md documents the implemented V2 surface: envelope fields,
  canonical identifiers, projections/rebuild, baselines/insights/incident
  lifecycle, /v2 API, observe-query client, SSE stream, alert webhooks,
  scopes, quarantine, archive/restore, phlo-observe CLI
- test: archive -> delete -> restore roundtrip through the CLI proves
  backup/restore works against the canonical ingest path (spec checklist:
  backup and restore documented and tested)

feat(observer): add alert cooldown and dedup

notify() takes a cooldown_key (insight dedupe key, falling back to the
insight id); repeat alerts for the same condition within 300s are
suppressed. The key map is bounded at 10k entries; a flush resets
cooldowns gracefully rather than growing forever.

perf(observer): batch projection and run-state updates in the ingest hot path

V2 projections added per-event and per-entity database round trips to
ingestion, dropping throughput below the CI performance floor. Fold each
accepted batch in memory, then flush entities, relationships, assets and
runs with a handful of bulk statements. The shared reducer is unchanged,
so incremental state still matches a full rebuild.

fix(observer): add observe-query to the image; fix help assertion on narrow terminals

The SDK gained a workspace dependency on observe-query but the Dockerfile
never copied it, so uv sync failed. The rebuild CLI help test asserted on
an option flag that Rich wraps on the CI terminal; strip newlines before
asserting.

test(observer): assert rebuild-projections exposes --run via its params

Rich renders an empty options panel in the CI environment, so help-text
assertions are not portable. Inspect the Typer command's parameters
instead.

feat(observer): serialize retention across instances; document HA and DR

Multiple observer instances each ran the retention loop, duplicating
deletes and contending on row locks. Retention now takes a Postgres
advisory transaction lock — holders run the pass, others skip and report
it. docs/v2.md gains high-availability and disaster-recovery sections,
and the V2 acceptance checklist reflects the implemented surface.
